name: Test Script Design Agent
tagline: Turns acceptance criteria into a passing Playwright + TypeScript test script, in any repository.
description: A RAG-grounded, tool-calling agent that reads your acceptance criteria, retrieves your repository's own coding standards and real Page Object code, generates a test script via guarded tool calls, actually executes it, and self-heals on failure until it passes (or exhausts its retry budget). Ships with an offline demo mode (no API key required) and a real OpenAI provider for production use.
configExampleLabel: agent.config.json (place at the root of your repo — auto-detected defaults apply if omitted)
setupSteps: git clone <this repo> (or npm install @agent-marketplace/agent-core @agent-marketplace/test-script-design-agent once published)
Add an agent.config.json to the root of the repository you want to generate tests into (optional — common folder names are auto-detected)
Run the CLI, pointing --target-repo at that repository

name: Test Case Generation Agent
tagline: Generates structured, reviewable test cases directly from requirements or user stories — before any code is written.
description: Will reuse the same agent-core engine (RAG retrieval + tool-calling) to produce structured test case documents (steps, expected results, priority, traceability to the requirement) for human review, as an earlier stage in the pipeline than script generation.

name: Self-Healing Agent
tagline: Automatically detects and repairs broken locators/tests when the application under test changes.
description: Will monitor failing test runs, diagnose whether a failure is a real regression or a stale locator/UI change, and propose (or auto-apply) a fix — built on the same tool-calling + execution-gated retry loop as the Test Script Design Agent.
